cotejo.intro: Cotejo {version} deterministic layer: the rules run with no model and no network, in a worker in your browser.
cotejo.source.sampleHint: A made-up {lines}-line spec, with {defects} seeded defects and its ground truth.
cotejo.paste.label: Your spec in Markdown
cotejo.paste.hint: Up to {max} lines. A longer spec goes through the CLI: npx cotejo analyze spec.md.
cotejo.paste.tooLong: That is {lines} lines and the demo accepts up to {max}. For a spec that long, use the CLI.
cotejo.paste.tooBig: The text goes over {max} characters. For a spec like that, use the CLI.
cotejo.paste.private: Your text never leaves your device: it is analyzed in a worker in this browser and stored nowhere.
cotejo.profile.label: Profile
cotejo.profile.cherced: The style of this site's specs
cotejo.evicted: The worker was closed to make room for another demo. Analyze again.
cotejo.failed: I could not analyze the text: {reason}
cotejo.done: Deterministic layer: {ms} ms in the worker ({roundTrip} ms round trip) for {lines} lines and {units} units. Profile {profile}, in {lang}.
cotejo.noProfile: I did not recognize the template, so I did not apply the structure rules.
cotejo.metrics.title: Precision and recall against the sample's ground truth
cotejo.metrics.precisionDetail: {tp} of {n} findings are in the ground truth
cotejo.metrics.c1: The deterministic layer found {found} of the {defects} defects that belong to it.
cotejo.metrics.semantic: What C1 does not see: {count} defects phrased in other words, two paraphrases and one contradiction. The semantic layers, below, propose them for review.
cotejo.metrics.semanticOn: With the semantic layers on, {found} of the {count} defects phrased in other words came up.
cotejo.metrics.falsePositives: False positives: {count}. They are marked with ✗ in the list, and their glass box says why they do not count.
cotejo.metrics.trace: The “possibly implemented” findings do not enter this count: they measure the repo, not the spec.
cotejo.metrics.family.caption: By family
cotejo.metrics.pasted: With your spec there is no ground truth to compare against: precision and recall are only measured with the sample.
cotejo.findings.title: Findings by family
cotejo.detail.score.fact: {score}: it is a fact and can be checked.
cotejo.detail.score.signal: {score}: it is a signal, with the fixed weight the rule declares.
cotejo.detail.truth.extra: Not in the sample's ground truth: it counts as a false positive.
cotejo.trace.title: Possibly implemented (C4)
cotejo.trace.intro: BM25 looks up each requirement in an index of the site, with a bridge of terms from Spanish to the code's names. It never says “already exists”: it gives the three most likely files, with each method's score.
cotejo.trace.size: It fetches the site index from this same site, about {size}, with no models.
cotejo.trace.failed: I could not load the site index. Check your connection and try again.
cotejo.trace.meta: Index from {date}: {files} files from app, components, lib and content/i18n, with {magnets} magnet files that weigh half. Search in {ms} ms.
cotejo.trace.variants.caption: The bridge from Spanish to code, measured against the sample's ground truth
cotejo.trace.col.hits: Exist and show up in the top 3
cotejo.trace.col.quiet: Do not exist and nothing is claimed
cotejo.trace.variant.glossary: With the lexicon and the spec's glossary
cotejo.trace.optimistic: The sample's glossary carries code names in backticks: that is the bridge, so the last row is an optimistic ceiling.
cotejo.trace.list: Requirements with medium or high confidence: {count}
cotejo.trace.none: No requirement went above low confidence, so the screen claims nothing.
cotejo.trace.score: score {score} · BM25 {bm25} · with the bridge {bridge} · literal ID {id}
cotejo.trace.truth.hit: ✓ According to the ground truth, it exists and showed up in the top 3.
cotejo.trace.truth.miss: ✗ According to the ground truth, it exists, but it did not show up in the top 3.
cotejo.trace.truth.absent: ✗ According to the ground truth, the site does not have it: this claim is extra.
cotejo.downloads.title: Download the report
cotejo.downloads.hint: The four outputs come from the same report, with the layers you have on. The JSON is the source of truth.
cotejo.downloads.failed: I could not prepare the download. Analyze again and try once more.
